mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE mobile = #{mobile})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, display_name, mobile, password_hash, user_type, status) VALUES (#{user.username}, #{user.displayName}, #{user.mobile, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{user.passwordHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{user.type}, #{user.status})
